name: Zentra aToken burn clamp lets repayWithATokens clear debt without burning
summary: Zentra, an Aave V3 fork on Citrea, upgraded its aTokens to an implementation whose _burnScaled caps the scaled burn at the holder's scaled balance with no bound on the difference. Pool.repayWithATokens burns the caller's aTokens and marks the debt repaid, so a caller holding no aTokens repays in full while burning nothing. With 200,000 flash-borrowed USDC.e as collateral, the attacker borrowed 140,000 ctUSD, cleared the debt with repayWithATokens and withdrew the collateral. It repeated this for 30 USDC.e.
notes: PoolConfigurator 0x6864042da4a5bbeb2a98e910599964c9d8b7b684, called by Zentra deployer 0x76be77a1, upgraded the zctUSD proxy from ATokenV2 0x2ec995d521d5248c15b874a5cfb80c65a7dc63f7 to AToken 0x62ff719a, which added the uncapped burn clamp. zUSDC 0x01465912c8cec266237050f429fe1b88daa56c0a received the same implementation two blocks earlier (block 9161294).

Net reserve depletion in the single exploit transaction. The zctUSD reserve paid 140,000 ctUSD in the borrow and received 0.000001 ctUSD net from the attacker's 50 supplied and 49.999999 withdrawn. The zUSDC reserve paid the 30 USDC.e borrow and kept 0.000001 of the 200,000 USDC.e collateral supplied and withdrawn. The debt tokens were burned without repayment. The PoC reports ~140,000 ctUSD + 30 USDC.e (~$143K).
